written_by: paper evaluator (the cell's agent), from the accepted population surface and the thirty frozen questions of competency-questions-v3.1.json only, before phase two
surface: 33 record types: ENTITY 26, EVENT 2, RELATION 5; subject-bearing types: Claim, CountObservation, DepthObservation, Observation, ReportedClaim, ReportedRatio, SeismicEvent; subtypes on the surface: ReportedClaim of Claim, CountObservation and DepthObservation of Observation, ReportedRatio of Ratio, BibliographicSource of Source, Dataset and NumericalModel and SoftwarePackage of DigitalResource, Melt of GeologicMaterial, SeismicEvent of Event, ContributionRelation and FundingRelation of ResearchRelation, FundingRelation of ContributionRelation
method: as run-23 and run-24 (E-0344, E-0348): one set per question id listing the types the question is about and every surface subtype of each listed type; under v4.13 a listed subject-bearing type reaches its subject-carrying records whatever their subjects' types (SUBJECT_ANY); the carrying types E-0342 found omitted are listed where the question asks for them (Instrument and SoftwarePackage on the recording-duration question, Dataset and the observation types on the catalogue question, the observation types on the crustal-thickness question); Ratio, Sample, Source, DigitalManifest and GeologicMaterial are never listed as such, their concrete subtypes are (ReportedRatio, Sample itself, BibliographicSource, Dataset and SoftwarePackage and NumericalModel, Melt); Entity is never listed, because every entity type is a subtype of it; BibliographicSource only where a study or publication record is asked; SeismicEvent where the question is about earthquakes as occurrences; Melt on the melt questions since this surface makes the melt a record; Evidence where an evidence relation is asked; ResearchRelation brings ContributionRelation and FundingRelation with it by the closure rule wherever a citation or an attribution is asked; run-24's sets map onto this surface one to one (ResearchCampaign to Campaign, ReportedQuantity to Observation with its two subtypes, InterpretiveClaim to ReportedClaim, PublishedWork to BibliographicSource, DataResource to Dataset, the five feature types to GeologicFeature, AnalyticalMethod to Method and NumericalModel, ScholarlyRelation to ResearchRelation, Contributor to ResearchAgent, FundingAward to the award identifier a FundingRelation carries, RockSample to Sample, MagmaticMelt to Melt, ElementRatio to ReportedRatio)
